providerPricesPerMillionTokensPublishedR: Provider prices per million tokens. Published rates apply to new requests. One point = ¥0.10; successful solver calls cost one point.
blockedInputIsRejectedWithoutChargeMatch: Blocked input is rejected without charge; matching streamed text is masked. Patterns support ? for one character. Allow phrases exempt only their matching spans. Image semantics are not moderated by this basic filter.
serviceMultiplierRequired: Required. Enter a multiplier greater than 0 for all models. It takes effect after publication.
configurationUnavailable: Configuration is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
deepseekPeakMondayFriday0912And14: DeepSeek peak: Monday–Friday, 09–12 and 14–18 Beijing time. Exact amounts are summed before rounding credits to four decimal places.
newRequestsWillUseThisConfigurationInFli: New requests will use this configuration. In-flight requests retain their original version. Gateway sync status is shown above.
modelCatalogHint: Users choose a model for each turn. Configure its provider route and rates before enabling it. Published changes affect new requests only.
maxImageBytesHint: The default and system maximum are 8 MiB; 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes. Both the original image and converted PNG must fit this input-size limit. It is not a token rate.
maxImagePixelsHint: The default and system maximum are 16 megapixels, calculated as original width × height (for example, 4000 × 4000). This limits decoding size, not token usage. Accepted images are then resized to at most 2048 pixels on the longest side.
imageTokensPerImage: Reserved input token bound per image
imageBudgetSharedInput: Shared text and image input limit
imageBudgetPerImageHint: Reserve the text estimate plus the bound for each image. Verify the per-image token bound against supplier rules or acceptance testing; settle using actual usage.
imageBudgetSharedInputHint: Each model call containing images shares a 262144 input-token reservation limit across all text and images; settlement uses actual usage. Calls continuing after tool execution are metered and reserved again. The per-image token field is unused, not a free image allowance. Text-only calls still reserve the text estimate.
imageBudgetHint: Images are validated and resized to at most 2048 pixels on the longest side. Configure a valid budget mode and image limits before enabling vision. Reserved amounts are not final charges; images resent with history are metered again.
rateMissing: Rates for this model are not published
imageBudgetMissing: Image limits or the selected budget mode are not fully configured
modelSettingsHint: Manage availability, names and rates within each model. Save, publish and restore all changes as one version. Configure the provider route before enabling a model.
changeDefaultBeforeDisabling: Choose another default model before disabling this model.
peakRatesHint: Peak hours are Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, excluding off-peak dates. Currency and exchange rate are shared with the base prices.
modelRateNotConfigured: Rates are not configured. Add the actual prices and publish them together with the enabled model.
modelSettingsDraftSaved: The combined draft is saved. Review and publish it from the version history below.
modelSettingsHistoryHint: Each version contains both model settings and rates. Publishing or restoring uses that version's saved contents, excluding unsaved edits.
modelSettingsLoaded: Loaded the model settings and rates from version {version}. Save a new draft after editing.
modelSettingsConfirmHint: All model settings and rates below will take effect together. New requests use the new version; requests in progress retain their original version.
gptLongContextInitializeHint: New tiers start at twice the current standard input and cached rates and 1.5 times the output rate, including peak rates, rounded up to at most 8 decimal places. Each price remains editable. Missing, invalid or out-of-range prices stay blank for manual entry.
gptLongContextHint: A call's actual total input, including cached and image tokens, selects the price tier for the entire call. Exactly 272000 tokens uses the standard tier; higher usage uses the long-context tier. Both tiers share the currency, exchange rate and service multiplier.
gptLongContextDisabled: This version has no long-context tier and uses the standard prices.
officialDeepseekHint: This route can back up the default DeepSeek route. It has independent prices and is not a separate user choice. Its routing is managed on the server.
offPeakDatesHint: These Beijing dates use base prices even during peak hours. Existing dates stay saved when peak pricing is disabled.
routeIdentityManaged: The server controls the upstream model. Changing a price does not change the route.
routeModelChanged: The current route uses {model}. Confirm its prices before binding this rate to that model.
modelSelectionScope: This switch controls user selection. The default DeepSeek route can still use fallback routes configured on the server.
cacheWriteHint: Uses the provider’s default cache duration. Enter a cache-write price for each tier.
cacheWriteDisabled: Cache writes are not priced separately
